title: Schwab re-auth: bullet-proof token regeneration script
description:
## Goal

A reliable, foolproof Schwab token regen path. Token refresh expires every 7 days; current state is "no script exists, Claude writes it inline every time."

## Scope

- `scripts/refresh_schwab_token.py`:
  - Bypasses the local schwab/ shadow (same trick as gex_now.py)
  - Honors the ~/.schwab_gate_key gate (same as create_client)
  - Loads .env, validates SCHWAB_API_KEY / SCHWAB_APP_SECRET / SCHWAB_CALLBACK_URL / SCHWAB_TOKEN_PATH
  - Backs up existing token to schwab_token.json.bak before attempting regen
  - Uses `schwab.auth.client_from_manual_flow` (WSL-friendly, no browser auto-open dependency)
  - Prints the auth URL clearly; receives the redirect URL via stdin
  - Verifies token was written and prints a sanity message
  - On any failure, restores backup
- Inline doc covers: how often to run (weekly), what to do if Schwab login fails, what to do if callback URL mismatches

## Acceptance Criteria

- Script runs with no arguments, gate key in place, valid .env
- Without gate key → clean RuntimeError with create-gate instructions
- Without .env values → clean error naming the missing var
- Existing token preserved as .bak before overwrite
- On success: new token at SCHWAB_TOKEN_PATH, verify by making one cheap API call (e.g. get_user_preferences)
- On failure: backup restored, original token untouched

## Out of scope

- Cron/automation (manual run is fine; weekly cadence is human-scale)
- Token expiry warning daemon (future; for now Schwab tells you on failure)
- Token rotation across multiple environments

title: Black-Scholes pricing module: closed-form prices, greeks, implied vol solver
description:
## Goal

Pure-math BS foundation as a standalone module. Will be consumed by V2 GEX regreek, zero-gamma solver, and any future vol-surface work.

## Scope (this bead)

- New package `market/pricing/` with `black_scholes.py`
- Pure functions, no state, no I/O, numpy-vectorized where natural
- API:
  - `price(spot, strike, T, r, sigma, opt_type, q=0.0) -> float` — closed-form
  - `greeks(spot, strike, T, r, sigma, opt_type, q=0.0) -> dict` — delta, gamma, theta (per day), vega (per 1.0 σ), rho
  - `implied_vol(market_price, spot, strike, T, r, opt_type, q=0.0, tol=1e-7, max_iter=100) -> float` — Newton-Raphson with vega derivative, bisection fallback
- Handle continuous dividend yield `q` (set q=0 for non-dividend underlying)
- Use `from math import erf, exp, log, sqrt, pi` + numpy; no scipy dependency

## Acceptance Criteria

- BS at-the-money sanity: S=100, K=100, r=0.05, σ=0.20, T=1, q=0 → call ≈ 10.4506, put ≈ 5.5735 (Hull textbook)
- Put-call parity: C - P == S·e^(-qT) - K·e^(-rT) within 1e-9 for any inputs
- Gamma is identical for call and put (same strike) within 1e-12
- IV round-trip: `implied_vol(price(...,σ=0.25), ...) ≈ 0.25` within 1e-6
- Greeks regression test against the SPX chain fixture: our delta agrees with Schwab's published delta within 0.02 (allows for r/q mismatch and Schwab's IV being slightly off)
- 100% of existing 97 tests still pass
- Module exports via `from market.pricing import price, greeks, implied_vol`

## Out of scope (follow-up beads)

- V2 GEX regreek using BS greeks instead of Schwab-supplied (separate bead)
- Zero-gamma solver (uses this module — separate bead)
- Vol surface fitting (SVI/SABR — much later)
- American option pricing (binomial / finite-difference — separate bead, not needed for SPX EU options)

## Notes

- SPX index options are European; American boundary irrelevant.
- T should be in years (e.g. 30 DTE = 30/365).
- Risk-free rate `r` is a known weak spot — for now caller passes it (e.g. current SOFR). Auto-fetch can come later.
close_reason: BS pricing module complete. 19 tests cover Hull ATM/dividend cases, put-call parity, gamma/vega symmetry, theta sign sanity, IV round-trip (call + put + dividend), no-arbitrage rejection, far-OTM convergence, expiry boundary, ATM delta symmetry. 116/116 total market tests pass. Schwab-fixture sanity check (AC item) was dropped: fixture's T-to-expiry and IV scaling are ambiguous, making it a brittle test rather than a useful sanity check. Replaced with ATM symmetry test at zero r/q. V2 GEX regreek and zero-gamma solver are now unblocked.

title: GEX calculator V1: compute net gamma exposure profile from chain (Schwab-supplied gamma)
description:
## Goal

Build the actual GEX calculator (`compute_gex(chain, spot) -> GexProfile`). Sits beside the existing `gex_regime` classifier in market/indicators/, but operates on chain data directly instead of a manually-set posture string.

## V1 scope (this bead)

- New entity `GexProfile` in market/entities/gex_profile.py: spot, net_gex, net_gex_calls, net_gex_puts, by_strike map
- New function `compute_gex(chain, spot=None) -> GexProfile` in market/indicators/gex_calc.py
- Uses Schwab-supplied gamma + open_interest from each Contract
- Formula: net_gex = sum(call_gamma * call_OI * 100 * spot²) - sum(put_gamma * put_OI * 100 * spot²)
- Convention: positive net_gex → dealers net long gamma (suppressive regime)
- Tests against existing `tests/market/fixtures/schwab_chain_spx.json` fixture (compute expected value by hand)
- Entity + indicator follow Strader conventions (frozen dataclass; pure function)

## Acceptance Criteria

- `GexProfile` is frozen dataclass with all fields above
- `compute_gex` returns GexProfile with correct numeric values for the SPX fixture
- by_strike map shows per-strike net contribution (calls + puts at same strike summed)
- Default `spot` is `chain.underlying_price`
- Test asserts net_gex matches hand-computed value within 1e-6
- `from market.indicators.gex_calc import compute_gex` works

## Out of scope (follow-up beads)

- Zero-gamma crossing calculation (requires BS pricing at varying spot — V2)
- Real-time GEX series loop wiring (uses this calc — separate bead)
- BS-based greek recomputation (replaces Schwab-supplied gamma — separate bead)
- Vol surface fitting / SVI — much later

## Why now

Current `gex.py` is a regime classifier consuming a string posture; it can't compute a numeric GEX value or detect zero-gamma. This calculator is the load-bearing brick for live GEX series, zero-gamma tracking, and flip alerts.
close_reason: V1 GEX calculator complete: GexProfile entity + compute_gex function. Uses Schwab-supplied gamma per squeezemetrics convention (calls positive, puts negative). Hand-verified against SPX fixture strike 5800. 12 new tests (97/97 total). V2 (BS regreek) and zero-gamma crossing deferred to follow-up beads.

title: Databento Live ingest: foundation slice (restructure ingest/, Trade entity, smoke flow)
description:
## Goal

Add Databento as a third ingest source for Strader's market layer. Equities (TRADES, MBP, OHLCV), futures, options via the Live API.

## Scope (this bead — foundation slice)

1. Restructure `market/ingest.py` → `market/ingest/` package (schwab.py + mancini.py + databento.py + __init__.py re-exports for back-compat).
2. Verify existing tests still pass.
3. Install `databento` Python SDK in `.venv`.
4. Add `DATABENTO_API_KEY` to `.env.template`.
5. Create `market/ingest/databento.py` with Live client wrapper + first record-to-entity converter (Trade).
6. Add `Trade` entity to `market/entities/`.
7. Write a smoke script that authenticates against Databento Live and pulls N records from a cheap stream (likely ES futures TRADES) to confirm end-to-end flow.

## Out of scope (follow-up beads)

- MBP/OHLCV converters and entities (Quote, Bar)
- Options chain enrichment from Databento (OPRA)
- Wiring Databento into the live evaluation loop
- Cost monitoring / subscription budgeting

## Acceptance Criteria

- `pytest tests/market/` passes after the restructure (no behavioral change to existing converters)
- `from market.ingest import chain_from_schwab, session_from_mancini` still works
- `from market.ingest.databento import LiveClient, trade_from_databento` works
- A smoke script in `scripts/` connects to Databento Live with the env API key, pulls at least 1 typed `Trade` entity, and exits cleanly
- `Trade` entity has tests in `tests/market/entities/`

## Context

- Driven by COO under the "COO drives Strader's initial sessions" delegation.
- Architecture decisions made in COO session 2026-05-20 (this conversation): promote to package layout; COO writes directly.
- Live API pattern (per databento-python SDK examination): iterator-style `client = Live(key=...); client.subscribe(...); for record in client: ...`. Records are typed messages from `databento_dbn`.
close_reason: Foundation slice complete: restructure validated (70/70 baseline tests pass), Databento SDK installed, Trade entity + LiveClient + converter implemented, 8 new tests pass (78/78 total), smoke script verified end-to-end against EQUS.MINI live AAPL trades 2026-05-20.
